title: Shift brief compactifier and sensitive snippet redactor
author: Aisha Kline
release_notes: Adds compact on-call shift brief generation and optional redaction pipeline for sensitive snippets in attachments; backward compatible with existing incident snapshot format.
description: Motivation: On lengthy incidents engineers asked for a short machine-generated shift brief that distills important actions, outstanding tasks, entropy signals, and a scrubbed list of potentially sensitive snippets from pasted logs/attachments. This PR implements a compactifier service plus a sensitive-snippet-redactor step that runs as an opt-in transform in the incident-bundles pipeline. Key goals: produce a one-page shift brief per shift that is under 500 words, safely redact short sensitive artifacts (e.g., keys, IP+token combos, customer identifiers) using conservative heuristics and allow on-call to review before export. Implementation summary: 1) incident-bundle/compactifier: new module that ingests existing snapshots and produces a structured brief (summary, timeline highlights, action items, outstanding blockers, suggested follow-ups). 2) incident-bundle/redactor: regex + heuristic-based redaction with a small allowlist/blocklist, plus a review flag that surfaces redacted excerpts to reviewers. 3) CLI: adds `incident-bot brief generate --bundle <id> --redact [--dry-run]` for local ops. 4) retention/config: feature flag controls automatic brief creation and redact defaults are conservative. 5) tests & docs: unit tests for redaction heuristics, snapshot fixtures, end-to-end e2e job, and docs for operators. Checklist: || - [x] Design reviewed with SRE and Security (ENG-2314) || - [x] Unit tests added for redactor edge cases || - [x] e2e smoke validated on staging bundle samples || - [x] Docs and CLI help updated || - [x] Rollout plan with feature flag and telemetry events described || Migration notes: existing snapshot schema unchanged; compactifier is additive and stored under bundle.briefs.v1. Toggle is off by default for existing customers. Monitoring: added brief_generation.count, brief_generation.duration_ms, redaction.count, redaction.false_positive_alert to observability. Backwards compatibility: brief consumers will ignore bundle.briefs if absent. Rollout plan: enable flag for internal orgs for 48h, gather FP stats, then enable opt-in for customers.
